personality_one_liner: A highly readable, location-first directory that frames local businesses with crisp typography, generous spacing, and vibrant warm accents.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding around content. Avoid dense grids. Whitespace frames actions.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Serve as the location-first entry point for rapid category browsing and semantic search.

states.empty: No businesses found in this area

screens.layout: Header: Location filter (Tirunelveli / Thoothukudi) + profile avatar. Below header: A full-bleed Hero card with the city landscape image, overlaid with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. The search bar floats over the bottom edge of this hero card. Below the fold: A 'Bento Box' 3-column grid of Categories (Battery, Hotels, etc.) using tinted containers.

screens.name: Business Listings
screens.purpose: Display search or category results with immediate actionability.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No businesses found. Try adjusting filters.'

screens.layout: Vertical list of stacked bento-style cards. Card top: Name, Category, Rating. Card Middle: Address, Distance, Owner Name. Card Bottom (Action Row): Call (brandPrimary), WhatsApp (surfaceSecondary with brand icon), Maps (surfaceSecondary with brand icon). The action row must sit above the fold for easy tapping.

screens.name: Business Detail
screens.purpose: Provide in-depth information and location context for a single business.
screens.layout: Hero: Large image of the business (or category fallback) with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Header becomes sticky glass on scroll. Content: Business Name, Owner Name, full address, map snapshot. Sticky bottom container: Full-width Call and WhatsApp action buttons.

screens.name: Add Business
screens.purpose: Allow users/owners to list a new business.
screens.layout: Clean, single-column scrollable form. Labels above inputs. Sticky 'Submit Listing' primary CTA at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView.

hero_city_landscape.alt: Vibrant city landscape with mountains representing Tirunelveli and Thoothukudi

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Expo fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans and DM Sans) loaded asynchronously. Do not exceed weight 500.
Implement the bento-box listing cards with a distinct bottom action row (Call, WhatsApp, Maps). 'Call' should be the prominent brandPrimary button.
Enforce the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 1 transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) on the Hero city landscape image and any Business Detail cover images.
Ensure safe area is respected at the root, and the Add Business/Detail screens use sticky CTA containers at the bottom above the home indicator.
Incorporate the district filter (Tirunelveli/Thoothukudi) at the very top of the Home screen, as location is the primary context.
Do NOT use emoji anywhere in the UI. Use Phosphor icons exclusively.
For the UI colors, use the provided Blue (brand) and Orange (brandPrimary) as explicitly requested by the user, avoiding default indigo.
